search_window.basis: Previous independently read-back verified Food Line Source Watch heartbeat in ops/watch-ledger. Publication dates and underlying event dates screened separately; no backdated event treated as new solely because it appeared in a fresh search.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only; primary nationwide Food Line collector remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss, closure, fire or disaster affecting only/sole/last/full-service community grocery store
Emergency food distribution canceled or suspended due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP, WIC or food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequence

coverage_notes.results: Twelve targeted fresh-index searches found no newly verified U.S. food-access disruption in the checked interval matching the four audit miss classes.

noteworthy_exclusions.reason: Spencer, NY sole grocery store loss occurred in September 2026; old incident, not new in this hourly window.
Earlier storm-related food-bank disruption; published in October 2026, outside new interval.
October 29 hurricane recovery service/resource information, not a newly verified November 3 canceled distribution.
November 2025 government shutdown SNAP interruption articles surfaced via month/day matches; excluded as prior-year reports.
November 2 school closure from flooding, without verified qualifying emergency-food distribution cancellation.

coverage_notes.limitations: Targeted 12-query web recall is not comprehensive national surveillance. Indexed publication recency can differ from event dates; unindexed provider notices may be missed. No generic food assistance, donation, recipe, inflation, or program-promotion results were promoted.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approvals, publications, schedule changes, task disabling, or production collection changes.
